titles.title: Domestic Petroleum Production Incentive Act of 1989
titles.titleType: Short Titles as Introduced for portions of this bill

titles.title: To amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to provide certain tax incentives for domestic oil and gas, to establish a domestic petroleum production program, to require the Strategic Petroleum Reserve to be filled with stripper well oil, and to eliminate certain restrictions on the sale of natural gas.
